cards.title: Order status transition: cancel() in the order service
cards.context: Add cancel(orderId, userId) to OrderService. Use a single conditional UPDATE so two concurrent cancels can't both succeed. Throw OrderNotCancellable for non-pending. Emit the OrderCancelled domain event after a successful update (T-04 subscribes to it). Ownership is already enforced by findForUser().

cards.title: Cancel endpoint: POST /api/orders/:id/cancel
cards.context: Route calls OrderService.cancel (T-01). Map OrderNotCancellable → 409, NotFound → 404. Response shape is the contract the frontend card (T-03) uses: { id, status }.

notes.note: attempt 1: reviewer asked for 404 test on foreign order

cards.title: Enqueue cancellation email
acceptance: AC-5: exactly one job per successful cancel
cards.context: Subscribe to the OrderCancelled domain event emitted by OrderService.cancel (T-01) and enqueue mailer job 'order-cancelled'. Template follows order-shipped.mjml.
